title: Double UPI debit, not complained yet
title_hi: दो बार UPI कटौती, अभी शिकायत नहीं की
text: PhonePe se 20 Oct ko 1,499 rupaye do baar kaat liye. UTR 629384710562. Abhi tak bank ya PhonePe ko complaint nahi ki. Paise wapas chahiye.

title: Complained on 2 Oct, no reply
title_hi: 2 अक्टूबर को शिकायत, कोई जवाब नहीं
text: PhonePe ne 1 Oct ko 1,499 do baar kaat liye, bank ko 2 Oct ko complaint ki, koi jawab nahi. Complaint number PP20261002118.

title: Bank rejected ATM complaint
title_hi: बैंक ने एटीएम शिकायत ख़ारिज की
text: SBI rejected my complaint about a failed ATM withdrawal of Rs 5,000 on 5 September 2026. I complained on 8 September 2026 and they replied on 20 September 2026 saying the transaction was successful. I am not satisfied.

title: Failed transaction (Hindi)
text: मेरे HDFC बैंक खाते से 12 अक्टूबर को ₹3,200 कट गए लेकिन लेनदेन विफल हुआ। मैंने 13 अक्टूबर को बैंक में शिकायत की, अभी तक कोई जवाब नहीं आया।

title: Refund not received for a return
text: Amazon has not refunded ₹2,349 for my returned order (order 408-1234567-1234567). The return was picked up on 3 October 2026.

title: Cancelled flight, refund pending
text: IndiGo ne meri flight 6 Oct ko cancel kar di, refund ₹7,800 abhi tak nahi mila. Customer care ko 7 Oct ko complaint ki thi.
